description: Usina Hidrelétrica de Samuel - RO is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Demanda da Superintendência Federal da Pesca e Aquicultura no estado de Rondônia, do Ministério da Pesca e Aquicultura, conforme SAPO nº 2800. Coverage: Brasil. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
